scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run build -w server && node deploy/copy-assets.cjs && node deploy/check-maps.cjs --files
